purpose: Operational instructions for agents preparing Postman, RapidAPI-style, generic API directory and MCP/tool registry listings.
primary_distribution_rule: Do not rely on human cold email. Place MachineSignal where software, CRMs, AI agents, API directories and workflow tools can discover, read, import and test it.

channels.workspace_description: MachineSignal is a machine-first lead opportunity scoring API for CRMs, AI agents, RevOps workflows and software platforms. A machine can create a limited sandbox key, read the product catalog, score domains, request Target Discovery, buy Deep Analysis when evidence is needed and buy Action Pack only after Deep Analysis confirms the action gate. This workspace is sandbox-only: no real payment, no fiscal invoice and no external target contact.
acceptance_checklist: Public docs show no API key, token or password.
base_url is visible and api_key is blank or secret.
First expected 200 path is clearly documented.
No claim says MachineSignal sends external outreach.
